hub.headline: Quesa is an open-source library that reimplements Apple's QuickDraw 3D API.
hub.next: Point readers to the Quesa maintainer and record a repeatable source build.
hub.what_it_was: Quesa began as a reimplementation of Apple's QuickDraw 3D APIs and grew into a 3D rendering and scene graph library for macOS and Windows. It works with OpenGL and the QuickDraw 3D 3DMF file format. Game Developer reported its 1.6d13 release as a portable open-source implementation of QuickDraw 3D.
hub.what_survives: Quesa is alive and its source is public on GitHub under the BSD-3-Clause licence.

name: Quesa
summary: Public records now track Quesa's QuickDraw 3D API reimplementation source and early cross-platform release reporting.
